test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rahul is shorter than Raman. Ramesh is shorter than Ravi but taller than Raman. Who among them is the tallest?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) Rahul is shorter than Raman.

 
• Raman > Rahul 

2) Ramesh is shorter than Ravi but taller than Raman.

 
• Ravi > Ramesh > Raman 

Thus final arrangement;

 
• Ravi > Ramesh > Raman > Rahul.

∴ Here, 'Ravi' is tallest among them.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ravi".**
